question: Which particle did JJ Thomson discover?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Electron**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **J.J. Thomson** (Joseph John Thomson), a **British physicist**, is credited with the discovery of the **electron** in the year **1897**.
 
• The discovery was made during his experiments with **cathode ray tubes** (CRTs). He observed that the rays were deflected by electric and magnetic fields, indicating they were composed of **negatively charged particles**. ***Hence, the correct option is Electron.***
 
• Initially, Thomson referred to these particles as **"corpuscles"** rather than electrons. He concluded that these corpuscles were the basic building blocks of atoms.
